entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I want to return this garbage you sent me. This is completely unacceptable!
I'm very sorry to hear that you're unhappy with your purchase. To get started, could you provide me with your order number?

It's VF88602. And don't give me the runaround. This jersey I ordered is the wrong size. It's way too tight and I can't even move in it. I've had it with you people. If I don't get a refund, I'm plastering bad reviews everywhere.

I understand your frustration, and I'll do my best to resolve this for you quickly. Let me just pull up that order... VF88602. Okay, I see the order here for the Pro-Series jersey. It looks like it was delivered 14 days ago.
So? Are you going to help me or not? I don't have time for this. Just tell me how to send it back.

Absolutely. According to our policy, standard items like this jersey are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can process this for you right now. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to exchange it for a larger size?
Oh. Well... fine. I guess an exchange is what I wanted in the first place. If you'd just sent the right thing, we wouldn't be having this conversation.

I apologize for the inconvenience. I've just initiated the exchange for one size up, and I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No. Just make sure it actually gets sent this time. Unbelievable.
I will personally ensure the exchange order is processed correctly. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
